# International Journal of Pharmaceutical Sciences (IJPS)

> A UGC-approved, Scopus-indexed peer-reviewed journal publishing cutting-edge research in pharmaceutics, pharmacology, pharmaceutical chemistry, and related pharmaceutical sciences.

IJPS is a leading academic publishing platform for pharmaceutical researchers and scholars, offering comprehensive manuscript submission, peer-review, and publication services with a focus on open access and research integrity. The journal maintains rigorous editorial standards and supports authors through detailed guidelines, tools, and transparent publication workflows.

## Key Topics

## Journal Overview & Scope

- [About Us](https://ijpsjournal.com/about-us): Overview of IJPS journal scope, peer-review process, and pharmaceutical sciences focus
- [Publication Area](https://ijpsjournal.com/publication-area): IJPS publication scope covering pharmaceutics, pharmacology, and chemistry research
- [Editorial Board Members](https://ijpsjournal.com/editorial-board): IJPS editorial board leadership including editor-in-chief and advisory members
- [Current Issue](https://ijpsjournal.com/current-issue): Latest IJPS research articles on autoimmunity, ethnopharmacology, and nanoparticles

## Manuscript Submission & Author Guidelines

- [Submit Manuscript](https://ijpsjournal.com/submit-manuscript): Submit manuscripts to IJPS, UGC-approved Scopus-indexed pharmacy journal
- [Authors Guidelines](https://ijpsjournal.com/author-guidelines): Detailed manuscript preparation and formatting instructions for IJPS authors
- [Model Manuscript](https://ijpsjournal.com/model-manuscript): IJPS manuscript template using Vancouver style with Times New Roman formatting
- [Tools For Authors](https://ijpsjournal.com/toolsForAuthor): IJPS author resources including plagiarism checker, Mendeley, and research software
- [Check Paper Status](https://ijpsjournal.com/check-paper-status): Online tool to track IJPS paper submission status and publication timeline

## Peer Review & Publication Process

- [Peer Review Process](https://ijpsjournal.com/peer-review-process): IJPS double-blind peer-review workflow ensuring research validity and ethics
- [Reviewer Guidelines](https://ijpsjournal.com/reviewer-guidelines): Guidelines for becoming IJPS reviewer with double-blind review process details
- [Editorial Policy](https://ijpsjournal.com/editorial-policy): IJPS editorial standards and peer-review process for publication criteria

## Research Ethics & Policies

- [Plagiarism Policy](https://ijpsjournal.com/plagiarism-policy): IJPS plagiarism detection and academic integrity policy for submissions
- [Open Access Policy](https://ijpsjournal.com/open-access-policy): IJPS open access publishing policy ensuring free article availability globally
